children: The CAC 40 fell 0.3% to 8,281 on Wednesday, its lowest level in more than a month.
As eurozone inflation rose to 3.3% and energy costs surged, markets increasingly priced in another rate hike later this month.
In France, the state budget deficit widened to EUR 145.9 billion in January–July 2026 from EUR 142 billion a year earlier.
Revenues rose 3.3% year-on-year to EUR 204.72 billion, while expenditures increased 4.8% to EUR 328.1 billion.
Meanwhile, oil prices remained elevated as conflicts in the Middle East persisted.
Luxury stocks closed mixed, with LVMH down 1.3% and Hermes losing 0.7%, while L’Oreal added 1.5% and Kering gained 1%.
Industrial stocks mostly fell, with Schneider Electric down 0.5%, Safran losing 0.9% and Thales declining 0.6%.
Financials were also mostly lower, with AXA down 0.9%.
In contrast, TotalEnergies rose 0.9% on higher energy prices.
STMicroelectronics rose 3.3%, with President and CFO Lorenzo Grandi set to address investors at Citi’s Global TMT Conference.

title: CAC 40 Drops as ECB Hike Bets Rise
